title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: 54. Calls for concrete and effective measures ensuring that fish caught in the Baltic Sea are increasingly directed towards direct human consumption, to promote and incentivise local food supply chains; calls on the Commission to assess the competitive position of EU Baltic flatfish producers, including producers of plaice and flounder, in the context of increased imports of substitute species such as yellowfin sole from non-EU countries, and to consider, where appropriate, internal market protection measures, including tariff adjustments or preferential sourcing requirements for EU processing facilities, to ensure a level playing field for Baltic small-scale demersal fishers;
